name: @expensify/victory-chart-renderer
description: Headless Bun CLI that renders Expensify chart XML to PNG using victory-native and Skia.

scripts.build:linux: node init && bun run scripts/build.ts --target bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/victory-chart-renderer-linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm: node init && bun run scripts/build.ts --target bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/victory-chart-renderer-linux-arm64
scripts.build:macos: node init && bun run scripts/build.ts --target bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/victory-chart-renderer-darwin-arm64
